body: Cause: native cwd trust is not inherited by new sessions/<role>/ dirs; not an argv bug. Code: launch() now detects 'Workspace not trusted' -> launch_state launch_untrusted, exit 6, actionable message naming the relative dir; no retry, no trust bypass, no read/write of global trust JSON; untrusted attempts are retryable by a new dispatch. Added plan option session_cwd isolated|shared (shared = trusted project root cwd, Bash rules use scripts/workflow.py) and read-only 'preflight' command. Tests: fake emits the observed untrusted stderr; new tests for untrusted detection/preservation and shared mode; existing failed-launch test kept. Live plan: evidence-librarian now owns evidence/ with required evidence/search-log.md, source-register.json, fulltext-manifest.json (matching actual outputs); nothing else changed. Docs: docs/workflow.md 'Workspace trust' troubleshooting + clone guidance + actual output locations.
